title: Add device capture verbs (photograph, snap, record) backed by effect_handlers/spawn.py sight and speech capture

sections.what: Expose native photograph/snap and record device verbs reusing engine/effect_handlers/spawn.py (_capture_recent sight/speech filtering) and is_device_active so phone- and camera-equipped characters can capture verifiable visual and audio evidence.
sections.why: engine/effect_handlers/spawn.py (_capture_recent, lines 17-84) already implements capture='sight' (camera photos excluding speech) and capture='speech' (recorder audio), yet no native character verbs exist in engine/action_verbs.py or routes/action_handlers.py - restricting capture solely to items manually authored with custom on_use spawn triggers.
sections.how: 1. Extract reusable capture_scene_media(world, actor, device_node, mode='sight'|'speech', target=None) reusing engine/effect_handlers/spawn.py _capture_recent (lines 17-84) and is_device_active (engine/long_distance_comms.py lines 13-58).\n2. Enforce physical constraints (lighting checks on sight capture, quiet/audible checks on audio capture, optional shutter flash/click witness event).\n3. Register photograph (alias snap) and record verbs in engine/action_verbs.py, routes/action_handlers.py, PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, and contextual-actions device prompts so stored captures appear in device media logs / child items inspectable via examine and show.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest covering photograph/snap and record with powered vs dead phones, darkness rejection on photos, and captured event inspection.

acceptance.text: photograph (alias snap) and record verbs are registered in engine/action_verbs.py, PlanGrounding, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts when carrying or holding an active camera or phone device.

Capturing creates an inspectable captured media record/child item via engine/effect_handlers/spawn.py (_capture_recent sight/speech logic) checking is_device_active, lighting (for sight captures), and optional shutter/shutter-sound/flash notice.
Captured photos and audio recordings can be inspected via examine and displayed to others via show/post without custom author-scripted on_use triggers per item.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal device action brackets (`photograph`, `record`) and Commons / item examine previews.

Current availability: engine/effect_handlers/spawn.py (_capture_recent, lines 17-84) already implements capture='sight' and capture='speech', yet only custom on_use triggers call it and no native phone/camera capture verbs exist.

Manual verification steps:
1. Equip/carry an active phone/camera in an area with recent visible/spoken events and execute `photograph` / `record`.
2. Inspect the resulting media entry/item with `examine` and share/show it.
   - expected: Captured sight/speech turns become concrete in-world media evidence inspectable across turns.

invalidation.reason: Duplicates existing engine/effect_handlers/spawn.py::_capture_recent (sight/speech capture from item triggers) and contradicts task-299 design decision ('Composition over verbs' - no per-device top-level actions).
